summary: Cosmic Journey: Last Sol Before the Storm is a browser-based, first-person 3D Mars exploration game developed for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Players take on a Mars exploration mission, following Perseverance rover routes, scanning 10 sample tubes, discovering scientific data, and completing objectives before an approaching dust storm. The game transforms real NASA and USGS datasets into an interactive experience, including Jezero Crater terrain, rover navigation, MEDA weather observations, Mars time, and authentic NASA images. Built with Three.js, WebGL, JavaScript, and GeoJSON, it combines scientific exploration, storytelling, and gamified learning. Players earn oxygen rewards by answering short quizzes, while a Field Bag stores collected photos, data, and samples. By clearly distinguishing scientific facts from fictional gameplay, Cosmic Journey makes complex Mars science accessible, engaging, and educational for students, teachers, and space enthusiasts worldwide.
details: Cosmic Journey – Last Sol Before the Storm is an interactive 3D first-person Mars exploration game that transforms real NASA scientific data into an immersive educational experience. Players can explore the Martian surface, discover real geographical locations, complete scientific missions, collect samples, and learn about Mars' environment, weather, and NASA rover missions. The project integrates real-world datasets from NASA and USGS, including Mars terrain maps, Perseverance rover routes, weather observations, and exploration images. Developed using Three.js, WebGL, JavaScript, and GeoJSON, the game combines scientific accuracy with gamification to make space science more accessible and engaging. Its main innovation is turning complex scientific datasets into an interactive virtual exploration experience, supporting STEM education, inspiring curiosity about space, and making Mars exploration accessible to everyone through a web browser.
